fix_commit_message:
[wasm][jspi] Disable SP-relative operands if wasm switches stacks

If a function switches to the central stack, this temporarily
invalidates the SP, so we disable using SP-relative memory operands for
this function.
This was only done for wasm builtins and wasm-to-js wrappers so far. We
also need to do this for regular wasm functions now since they may
switch for Fast API calls.
Detect this more precisely based on the presence of the SetStackPointer
instruction.

R=jkummerow@chromium.org

Fixed: 408242499

agent_reasoning: Merged diff composed mechanically by cherry-picking fix 050587ff9533 on top of intro 5e09e2aaf1df via git's 3-way merge. Vulnerability (LogicError):  Root cause: The guard that disables SP-relative memory operand generation (SetFPRelativeOnly) in src/compiler/backend/code-generator.cc only covered WASM_TO_JS_FUNCTION code kind, kWasmToJsWrapperCSA, and wasm builtins. When commit 5e09e2aaf1d added SetStackPointer to regular wasm function code paths (for Fast API calls), the WASM_FUNCTION code kind was not included in the guard, leaving the SP-relative operand optimization active during stack switches.
